steps.label: 3408-lab-math-rich-editor-toolbar-focus
command: (()=>{if(location.pathname!=='/lab/view/math-demo.donga'||window.MathFieldDialog.get().backdrop.style.display!=='none')throw Error('Expected closed math dialog');const e=window.tinymce.get('mre1');if(!e)throw Error('Inline math editor unavailable');e.focus();const p=e.getBody().querySelector('p');e.selection.select(p,true);e.selection.collapse(false);return {active:document.activeElement.id,toolbar:[...document.querySelectorAll('.tox-toolbar button,.tox-toolbar__primary button')].filter(b=>b.getClientRects().length).map(b=>({text:b.textContent.trim(),aria:b.getAttribute('aria-label'),title:b.title}))};})()
